title: Middle of the Linked List
statement: Return the middle node of a singly linked list; for an even number of nodes, return the second middle.

title: Middle of the Linked List
statement: Return the middle node of a singly linked list; for an even number of nodes, return the second middle.
code: class Solution { public ListNode middleNode(ListNode head){ListNode slow=head,fast=head;while(fast!=null&&fast.next!=null){slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next;}return slow;} }

title: Projection Area of 3D Shapes
statement: For a grid of column heights, return the total area of its projections onto the xy, yz, and zx planes.
approach_name: Sum top, row, and column projections

title: Projection Area of 3D Shapes
statement: For a grid of column heights, return the total area of its projections onto the xy, yz, and zx planes.
approach_name: Sum top, row, and column projections
code: class Solution { public int projectionArea(int[][] grid){if(grid.length==0)return 0;int top=0,rows=0,cols=0;for(int r=0;r<grid.length;r++){int max=0;for(int c=0;c<grid[0].length;c++){if(grid[r][c]>0)top++;max=Math.max(max,grid[r][c]);}rows+=max;}for(int c=0;c<grid[0].length;c++){int max=0;for(int r=0;r<grid.length;r++)max=Math.max(max,grid[r][c]);cols+=max;}return top+rows+cols;} }

title: Uncommon Words from Two Sentences
statement: Return words that occur exactly once across the two sentences.

title: Uncommon Words from Two Sentences
statement: Return words that occur exactly once across the two sentences.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String[] uncommonFromSentences(String s1,String s2){Map<String,Integer>m=new HashMap<>();for(String w:(s1+" "+s2).split(" ")){m.put(w,m.getOrDefault(w,0)+1);}List<String>out=new ArrayList<>();for(String w:m.keySet())if(m.get(w)==1)out.add(w);return out.toArray(new String[0]);} }

statement: Return one candy-size pair to swap so Alice and Bob have equal total candy, assuming a solution exists.

title: Fair Candy Swap
statement: Return one candy-size pair to swap so Alice and Bob have equal total candy, assuming a solution exists.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] fairCandySwap(int[] a,int[] b){int delta=(Arrays.stream(a).sum()-Arrays.stream(b).sum())/2;Set<Integer>s=new HashSet<>();for(int x:b)s.add(x);for(int x:a)if(s.contains(x-delta))return new int[]{x,x-delta};return new int[0];} }

title: Monotonic Array
statement: Return true if an array is entirely nondecreasing or entirely nonincreasing.
code:
class Solution:
 def isMonotonic(self,nums):return all(nums[i]<=nums[i+1] for i in range(len(nums)-1)) or all(nums[i]>=nums[i+1] for i in range(len(nums)-1))

title: Monotonic Array
statement: Return true if an array is entirely nondecreasing or entirely nonincreasing.
code: class Solution { public boolean isMonotonic(int[] a){boolean inc=true,dec=true;for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++){if(a[i]<a[i-1])inc=false;if(a[i]>a[i-1])dec=false;}return inc||dec;} }

title: Increasing Order Search Tree
statement: Rearrange a BST so its inorder sequence becomes a tree with no left children and only right children.
approach_name: Inorder rebuild as a right-only chain
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public TreeNode increasingBST(TreeNode root){List<Integer>v=new ArrayList<>();inorder(root,v);TreeNode dummy=new TreeNode(0),cur=dummy;for(int x:v){cur.right=new TreeNode(x);cur=cur.right;}return dummy.right;}private void inorder(TreeNode n,List<Integer>v){if(n!=null){inorder(n.left,v);v.add(n.val);inorder(n.right,v);}} }

title: Sort Array By Parity
statement: Return an array with all even integers before all odd integers.
code:
class Solution:
 def sortArrayByParity(self,nums):return [x for x in nums if x%2==0]+[x for x in nums if x%2!=0]

title: Sort Array By Parity
statement: Return an array with all even integers before all odd integers.
code: class Solution { public int[] sortArrayByParity(int[] nums){int[]a=new int[nums.length];int i=0;for(int x:nums)if(x%2==0)a[i++]=x;for(int x:nums)if(x%2!=0)a[i++]=x;return a;} }

title: Smallest Range I
statement: Return the smallest possible difference between maximum and minimum after each value may change by at most k.
code:
class Solution:
 def smallestRangeI(self,nums,k):return max(0,max(nums)-min(nums)-2*k)

title: Smallest Range I
statement: Return the smallest possible difference between maximum and minimum after each value may change by at most k.
code: class Solution { public int smallestRangeI(int[] nums,int k){int min=Integer.MAX_VALUE,max=Integer.MIN_VALUE;for(int x:nums){min=Math.min(min,x);max=Math.max(max,x);}return Math.max(0,max-min-2*k);} }

title: X of a Kind in a Deck of Cards
statement: Return true if the deck can be split into groups of equal size X, where X is at least 2 and every group contains identical cards.
code:
from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce
class Solution:
 def hasGroupsSizeX(self,deck):return reduce(gcd,Counter(deck).values())>=2

title: X of a Kind in a Deck of Cards
statement: Return true if the deck can be split into groups of equal size X, where X is at least 2 and every group contains identical cards.
code: class Solution { public boolean hasGroupsSizeX(int[] deck){int[]cnt=new int[10000];for(int x:deck)cnt[x]++;int g=0;for(int c:cnt)if(c>0)g=gcd(g,c);return g>=2;}private int gcd(int a,int b){while(b!=0){int t=a%b;a=b;b=t;}return a;} }

title: Reverse Only Letters
statement: Reverse only the letters in a string, leaving non-letter characters in their original positions.
code: class Solution { public String reverseOnlyLetters(String s){char[]a=s.toCharArray();int l=0,r=a.length-1;while(l<r){if(!Character.isLetter(a[l]))l++;else if(!Character.isLetter(a[r]))r--;else{char t=a[l];a[l]=a[r];a[r]=t;l++;r--;}}return new String(a);} }
